newsitem.title: Croatia: Croatia sells 182-day bills, rate falls.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells 182-day bills, rate falls.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said it raised 40 million kuna in 182-day treasury bills at an auction on Tuesday.
The rate fell to 10.74 percent from 11.25 percent four weeks ago. The issue was priced at 94.917 percent compared to 94.688 at the last auction.
Bills are payable in two days and mature on December 18.
The ministry put the sahre of non-banking investors at 26.75 percent compared to way below one percent when the 182-day bills were first issued.
It announced the next auction for June 24, when 60 million kuna in 91-day T-bills will be offered. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385 1 4557075
